text_block_list.text: (Ding dong dang dong)

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

While preparing for training, I could hear 
the footsteps of Umamusume in the 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let you! Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student C
text_block_list.text:
Kya! ...N-No way. She passed me in a split 
second...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!! ...Alright, first to arrive today 
too.

The first to rush in was Calston Light O. 
Soon after, more and more Umamusume showed 
up.
choice_data_list:
You didn't bump into any obstacles today, 
did you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I dodged it. It only takes a slight 
shift of the body to evade.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
With my core strengthened, it's a breeze 
for me now. —And then, I realized 
something.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Bumping hurts. When it hurts, you can't 
run fast. So it's faster not to bump into 
anyone!
choice_data_list: You're only just realizing that now!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Could it be because I've gotten too fast? 
Lately, the pain when I bump into things 
is no joke.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's what they call a double-edged sword, 
isn't it?

Your interpretation isn't wrong, but... 
even a double-edged sword wouldn't want to 
be used like this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Light O-senpai was the first one 
here again? And here I thought I'd beat 
her today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Me too. As soon as the chime rang, I 
dashed straight out of the classroom~."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Our experience is on completely 
different levels.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, is that race to be 
first a trend now?

text_block_list.text:
It used to be just Calstone Light O, but 
lately everyone has started racing each 
other to the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it's trendy, exactly. It's 
more that I get to compete with Right 
O-san~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat Light O-senpai, the 
fastest! Then I'll be the fastest, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wants to be the fastest. 'Cause 
we're Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering why everyone's been 
challenging me so aggressively lately. So 
that's why.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to go to all that trouble. 
Why not just train side by side?
Wah, really?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Then~ ehehe. Right O-san, would you 
please run alongside Curren?♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to become even cuter, just 
like you, Right O-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mar-chan would also like to ask this of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A run that stays in everyone's memories. I 
wish to understand the know-how behind it. 
I will use it as reference.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair! Right O-senpai, race with 
me too!
choice_data_list: Why don't we make it a mock race instead?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. Competition is more than 
welcome.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I know I can get faster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's full of motivation! That's 
wonderful to see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to be the fastest of all! Fufu, 
this is going to be lively!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're having fun, Bakushin 
O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's bound to be a lot of fun! And 
so!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-saaan! Let me join the practice 
race too!"

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—It's spreading, isn't it? From one 
Umamusume to another.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Drawn by that ultimate speed... that 
sheer velocity.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"To reach it with my own legs. To surpass 
that speed. An Umamusume's instincts must 
be screaming for it."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
And so, it connects... To future 
Umamusume. To the future.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Who will reach beyond, surpassing the 
light? Perhaps she will be the one to 
transcend it once more.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Beyond top speed. An Umamusume desires it, 
and keeps on running...
